readings.moment: At the annual dinner, when the temple struck nine, the husband had everyone show their watches (habitual; stated as what happens each year)
At the dinner ritual, when the husband checked the guests' watches, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
While Madame and Casimir were playing piquet in the salon, the temple struck ten
When the doctor went out of the room to fetch his cigars
A moment after the doctor came back, the hall clock struck eleven

durations: a moment after he came back (between the doctor's return and the hall clock striking eleven)
whereabouts: The family and guests dined together, as they do every year; the husband did the watch-showing at the table with his napkin on his knee.
Félix was at the dinner table, where Aurèle scolded him about his watch.
Monsieur Girard and the husband quarrelled about the repeater at dinner.
Madame and Casimir played piquet in the salon after dinner, without a break.
The doctor left the salon/room at 10:28 to fetch his cigars, which he had left in his coat.
Before leaving, the doctor asked Madame to play for him.
Madame sat down at the piano at once and played Chopin until the doctor came back, then stopped when he came in.
The doctor came back into the room with damp cigars.
Madame states that she wishes to go up to her room and be alone.
